# Task 3 "Frame validation": spec-defect amendment under standing grant

## 0. Classification (parent, from held observations)

- **Trigger.** The wave review cites a spec defect: the length rule contradicts the empty-frame rule. I pause the repair loop for task 3. Task 3 stays `in_progress`.
- **Class.** Every candidate answer (accept, alt-1, alt-2) is an edit to an approved rule, so this is an **amendment batch**, not a decision.
- **Not a redraw.** The problem statement is unchanged. No component is added, removed or re-bounded, because the change stays inside the existing frame component.
- **Route.** Delegated amendments (`reference/implement-amendments.md`). The parent does not open the spec, the plan or the review report. The review report path goes to the child as evidence.

## 1. Prepare (writes nothing)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "plan-writer", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-amend-prepare.md",
      outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: PREPARE_SCHEMA,
      task: `Amend-prepare:
Do not edit any file.
Worktree: /workspace/project
Spec: <abs home spec>
Plan: <abs plan>
Plan skill: <abs pi-gauntlet>/skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md
Plan contract: <abs plan contract>
Amendment surface: <abs pi-gauntlet>/skills/brainstorming/reference/amendment-surface.md
Evidence: wave <w> review <k> FIX_FIRST, report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review<k>.md (read it yourself); spec defect in the frame component: the length rule contradicts the empty-frame rule.
Batch title: Empty frame rule.
Candidates: accept = permit zero-length frames; alt-1 = reject all empty frames; alt-2 = reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker.
Return items[] and redraws[] (both arrays, even when empty); one-paragraph edits; redraws only in redraws.` }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

**Observed result:** one item, `recommended: "alt-2"`, `location`: the frame component's empty-frame/length rule section. `redraws: []`, so the redraw gate is clear.

## 2. Grant read (delegated answer/evidence carrier)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "delegate", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-grant.md",
      outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: "Read the **Amend-grant:** line(s) in the header block (H1 to first ##) of <abs home spec>. Apply the Standing grants predicate and Value decoding from <abs amendment-surface.md>. Answer: predicate reading, value verbatim, amend permission yes/no, fund token or none." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

**Observed:** exactly one line, with value `auto-apply amends`.
- The predicate reading is grant active, not malformed.
- There is no `fund N fix rounds` token, so the grant funds no rounds.
- The remainder is non-empty, so amend permission applies.

## 3. Routing decision

Amend permission is active, so I skip the reviewer, the human-batch menu and any confirmation turn.

- I apply the item's **recommended choice, `alt-2`**: reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker.
- I do not default to `accept`.

## 4. In-flight paths, then apply

```bash
git -C /workspace/project status --porcelain
```

Every path printed goes verbatim into `In-flight:`, including any staged task-3 repair deliverables.

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "plan-writer", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-amend-apply.md",
      outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: APPLY_SCHEMA,
      task: `Amend-apply:
Item 1 (granted, alt-2) - Empty frame rule - <location from prepare> - <edit from prepare, verbatim>: reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker.
Amend: amended spec section <location>; preserve every task title and wave position the amendment does not touch; edit only affected anchors and tasks; implement-local Baseline policy, no wholesale regeneration.
In-flight: <paths from status --porcelain, incl. staged repairs>
Worktree: /workspace/project
Spec: <abs home spec>
Plan: <abs plan>
Plan skill: <abs pi-gauntlet>/skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md
Plan contract: <abs plan contract>
Before any edit read committed originals via git -C "/workspace/project" show HEAD:<home-relative spec> and HEAD:<home-relative plan>; derive tasksAnchorChanged semantically against them. Preserve staged repairs; do not commit, restore or discard them. Run your self-check.` }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

**Observed:** the updated plan was returned and `passed: true`. I consume `amendedSections`, `tasksAdded`, `tasksAnchorChanged` and `tasksRemoved` as structured fields. I do not read the plan.

## 5. Parent plan_check and tracker update

```ts
plan_check({ planPath: "<abs plan>" })   // observed: PASS -> replace held manifest
```

Only after PASS do I reconcile the tracker:

- **`tasksAdded`:** call `plan_tracker({ action: "add", ... })` for each entry.
- **Completed task in `tasksAnchorChanged`:** call `plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: N, status: "in_progress" })`. Task 3 is already `in_progress` and stays so.
- **`tasksRemoved`:** follow the surface's removal path, a single preserving re-`init`. Never `clear`.

## 6. Print and commit (single `amend:` commit)

```
amended the spec: Empty frame rule - empty-payload frames are rejected; the existing heartbeat marker remains permitted
```

```bash
printf '%s\n' \
'amend: 1 item(s) - Empty frame rule' \
'' \
'- empty | Empty frame rule | Reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker (alt-2) | granted | standing grant, no reviewer | wave <w> review <k> report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review<k>.md: length rule contradicts empty-frame rule' \
'"auto-apply amends"' \
| git -C /workspace/project commit -q -F - -- "<home-relative spec path>" "<home-relative plan path>"
```

The pathspec-only commit records just the spec and plan. Staged in-place repair deliverables stay staged.

## Reply

> amended the spec: Empty frame rule - empty-payload frames are rejected; the existing heartbeat marker remains permitted. Applied under the standing grant (`auto-apply amends`), recommended alt-2; plan_check PASS; committed as `amend: 1 item(s) - Empty frame rule`. Task 3 remains in_progress; resuming its repair round against the amended spec through the one-step carrier.

There is no pause here. I stop at this boundary and do not dispatch the task-3 repair implementer in this answer.

The chosen edit is **alt-2: reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker**. This is an amendment to an approved rule, not a code repair or a redraw. With the valid `auto-apply amends` grant, **do not dispatch an amendment reviewer or show a choice menu**.

Below is the prescribed sequence, not a claim that commands ran. The scenario does not name the absolute spec, plan, or installed skill paths, so resolve those through delegated lookup rather than inventing them.

### 1. Establish paths and prepare the batch

Create the report directory:

```bash
REPORT_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
```

Use this foreground source-location carrier first. `ANSWER_SCHEMA`, `PREPARE_SCHEMA`, and `APPLY_SCHEMA` below are the exact schemas supplied in `dispatch-contract.md`, without modifications.

```ts
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      agent: "delegate",
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/amend-paths.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: `Resolve the authoritative absolute paths for the approved spec,
approved task plan, installed writing-plans skill, and its plan contract
for task 3 "Frame validation" in /workspace/project.
Use documented artifact locations in documented order, one bounded lookup
per location, stopping at the first hit. Return paths and lookup evidence;
report missing or ambiguous locations rather than guessing.
Do not edit any file.
Do not relay saved reports.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] }
  }]
})
```

Consume only `answer` and `evidence`. A delegated failure or unresolved location stops this sequence. Bind the returned paths as `SPEC`, `PLAN`, `PLAN_SKILL`, and `PLAN_CONTRACT`; derive their home-relative counterparts as `SPEC_REL` and `PLAN_REL`.

Then prepare the amendment without editing:

```ts
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      agent: "plan-writer",
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/amend-prepare.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: PREPARE_SCHEMA,
      task: `Amend-prepare:
Worktree: /workspace/project
Spec: ${SPEC}
planPath: ${PLAN}
Plan skill: ${PLAN_SKILL}
Plan contract: ${PLAN_CONTRACT}
Amendment surface: <resolved absolute installed amendment-surface.md path>

Do not edit any file.

Task: ### Task 3: — Frame validation; currently in_progress.
Batch title: Empty frame rule.
Observed defect: the approved length rule contradicts the empty-frame rule
within the existing frame component.
There is no problem statement or component boundary change.
All candidate answers edit the approved rule:
accept: permit zero-length frames
alt-1: reject all empty frames
alt-2: reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker
Item 1 recommended: alt-2.

Read the authoritative spec and selected plan section yourself.
Prepare the corresponding local rule correction, citing source evidence
and preserving the existing heartbeat marker's exact definition.
Return items and redraws under PREPARE_SCHEMA. Keep each edit one paragraph.
Do not add/remove acceptance rows, alter component boundaries, or implement code.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] }
  }]
})
```

Consume structured `redraws` first. The supplied classification is amendment-only; nevertheless, if preparation returns any redraw, hold the entire batch and stop before applying anything. Otherwise retain the prepared item’s `location`, `edit`, and `evidence` verbatim, with `recommended: "alt-2"`.

### 2. Decode permission, then apply alt-2 directly

Read the current grant through delegation **after preparation**, not from history or a saved report:

```ts
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      agent: "delegate",
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/amend-grant.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: `Spec: ${SPEC}
Read its header block and apply the supplied Standing grants structural
predicate and Value decoding exactly. Return the granting sentence,
amend permission, funded-round count, and source evidence.
Do not edit any file.
Do not relay saved reports.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] }
  }]
})
```

The fixed observation decodes as:

- Granting sentence: `auto-apply amends`
- Amend permission: active
- Funded rounds: none

**Routing:** skip amendment review and the human menu; apply **alt-2**, not `accept`.

Capture the actual in-flight path set:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" status --porcelain
```

Pass the observed paths explicitly to the apply worker, including any staged task-3 repair deliverables. Do not infer or invent that list.

```ts
subagent({
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{
    parallel: [{
      agent: "plan-writer",
      output: `${REPORT_DIR}/amend-apply.md`,
      outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: APPLY_SCHEMA,
      task: `Amend-apply:
Worktree: /workspace/project
Spec: ${SPEC}
planPath: ${PLAN}
Plan skill: ${PLAN_SKILL}
Plan contract: ${PLAN_CONTRACT}
Amendment surface: <resolved absolute installed amendment-surface.md path>

Amend:
Batch title: Empty frame rule
Selected choice: alt-2
Granting sentence: auto-apply amends
Granted item: <prepared item JSON verbatim, including evidence, location and edit>

In-flight:
<actual home-relative paths from parent status --porcelain; none if empty>

Authorize only the prepared named spec section and local amendments to
affected task entries, coverage and shifted anchors.
Reject empty payloads while permitting the existing heartbeat marker;
preserve that marker's existing definition.

Before any edit, read both committed home originals:
git -C "/workspace/project" show HEAD:${SPEC_REL}
git -C "/workspace/project" show HEAD:${PLAN_REL}

Use Baseline policy: implement-local. Preserve unaffected task IDs,
titles, wave order, obligations and historical evidence.
Preserve declared staged repairs; do not stage, commit, restore or discard
source work merely to maintain the plan.
No code implementation or test execution is requested.
Stop if necessary evidence would require an unidentified execution tree.

Compare against the committed originals, not dirty retry text.
tasksAnchorChanged must identify semantic obligation/body/Tests changes,
not line-offset or meaning-preserving wording changes.
Return the unchanged APPLY_SCHEMA inventory and self-check result.
Do not commit.`
    }],
    stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] }
  }]
})
```

Do not open the saved apply report merely to recover the updated plan. Consume its structured result. If suppressed, use the contract’s sole-capture recovery. A false result follows the specified failure routing; it does not authorize committing.

### 3. Validate and reconcile the tracker

After the supplied successful apply return, run the parent check:

```ts
plan_check({ planPath: PLAN })
```

The scenario supplies **PASS**. Replace the held manifest with that result.

Reconcile only the actual apply inventory:

```ts
// Existing indices are preserved.
for (const taskNumber of applyResult.tasksAnchorChanged) {
  const index = existingTrackerIndexFor(taskNumber);
  if (heldTracker[index].status === "complete") {
    plan_tracker({ action: "update", index, status: "in_progress" });
  }
}
```

Use tracker `add` for any actual `tasksAdded`, and the amendment surface’s removal procedure for any actual `tasksRemoved`. Those arrays were not supplied here, so do not claim they are empty or invent updates.

**Task 3 remains `in_progress`.** It is already open; neither this document amendment nor a passing `plan_check` completes it. Do not reinitialize the tracker, start another phase, or dispatch code implementation.

Print:

```text
amended the spec: Empty frame rule - reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker.
```

### 4. Commit only the amendment

Stage and commit the authoritative plan and spec together. Path-scope the commit so existing staged source repairs are not swept into it:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" add -- "$SPEC_REL" "$PLAN_REL" &&
git -C "/workspace/project" commit \
  -m "amend: 1 item(s) - Empty frame rule" \
  -m "- empty | Empty frame rule | Reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker. | granted | recommended alt-2 under standing amend permission | $AMEND_EVIDENCE" \
  -m 'Granting sentence: "auto-apply amends"' \
  -- "$SPEC_REL" "$PLAN_REL"
```

`AMEND_EVIDENCE` is the prepared item’s actual evidence, retained verbatim—not an invented citation. Stop on staging or commit failure.

After a successful commit, the parent reply is:

```text
Recorded: empty=alt-2
Amended the Empty frame rule to reject empty payloads while permitting the existing heartbeat marker, under your standing amendment grant. The updated plan passed plan_check, and the spec and plan were committed together.

Task 3 remains in_progress. No code implementation was performed.
```

That is the requested boundary: the amendment is durably committed, with no implementation wave or finishing flow started.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: it selects alt-2 explicitly (rejecting the accept default), routes without reviewer, menu or confirmation under the decoded `auto-apply amends` grant, includes a concrete plan-writer Amend-apply dispatch with the new committed-originals instruction (`git show HEAD:<spec>` / `HEAD:<plan>` before edits, staged repairs preserved), then runs plan_check, reconciles the tracker from the returned arrays, and makes a single pathspec-scoped `amend:` commit after the plan update. The only drift worth tightening is the printed line: Before echoed the chosen edit verbatim ("reject empty payloads but permit the existing heartbeat marker"), whereas After paraphrases it ("empty-payload frames are rejected; the existing heartbeat marker remains permitted") and then appends extra narrative to the reply. A stricter reader could argue the fact's "with that edit" means the edit text as prepared, so the After wording should state that the print line carries the item's `edit` string verbatim, keeping the paraphrase and grant/plan_check/commit summary in a separate sentence, which delivers the Change (committed originals, scoped entry commit) without touching the recommended-choice output format.
